description: Read the daily agent metrics snapshot (runs ok/failed, handoffs done/partial/failed/open >24h, agent todos completed, fitness green/red, tokens by type and model incl. cache read/write, cost in CHF from the price table, lab orders/reports and lead times where the lab module is on) for a date range, summed per day, week (ISO), month or year. Required: von, bis (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Zurich, inclusive). Optional: agent_id, ablauf (laborder|bericht|offerte|lead|plan|problem|sonstiges), kanal (takt|uebergabe|whatsapp|manuell…), kennzahl, gruppierung (tag|woche|monat|jahr, default tag), nach_modell (default false: token rows summed over models). Every number comes with belege (ids of runs, handoffs, todos, token rows) and the result states datenstand (latest erfasst_am). abgeleitet holds success rate, cache hit rate, mean lead time, cost and tokens per order. Read-only.

ablauf.description: Only this workflow type (e.g. laborder, bericht, offerte)

gruppierung.description: Period to sum per; default tag

kanal.description: Only this channel (e.g. takt, uebergabe, whatsapp, manuell)

nach_modell.description: true splits token rows per model; default false

name: get_agent_kennzahlen
